executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 87 errors across multiple files. The root cause is missing Lombok annotations (@Data, @Builder) on entity and DTO classes, causing the compiler to not find generated getter/setter/builder methods. Additionally, there is a duplicate constructor definition and a missing interface method implementation.

errors.root_cause: Duplicate constructor definition in ColumnNotFoundException class. Lombok @AllArgsConstructor may be conflicting with manually defined constructor.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the duplicate constructor at line 9, or remove @AllArgsConstructor annotation if manually defining constructors.

errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse class is missing @Builder annotation, causing 6 compilation errors in GlobalExceptionHandler where builder() method is called.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder annotation to ErrorResponse class. Ensure @Data or @Getter/@Setter annotations are also present.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: methods getId(), setId(), getTitle(), getStatus(), getUserId(), getCreatedAt(), getUpdatedAt(), setUpdatedAt(), etc.
errors.root_cause: Task entity class is missing @Data or @Getter/@Setter annotations. This causes 50+ compilation errors across InMemoryTaskDataStore, TaskDataStoreImpl, and TaskServiceImpl where getter/setter methods are called.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data annotation to Task entity class. Also add @Builder annotation if builder pattern is used. Verify all required fields have appropriate access modifiers.

errors.message: does not override abstract method countByColumnId(String) in TaskDataStore
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore does not implement the countByColumnId() method required by TaskDataStore interface.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add implementation for countByColumnId(String columnId) method in InMemoryTaskDataStore class. Return the count of tasks matching the given columnId.

errors.root_cause: ColumnTaskCountResponse class is missing @Builder annotation, causing compilation error in ColumnServiceImpl.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: methods getUserId(), getTitle(), getDescription(), getPriority(), getDueDate()
errors.root_cause: TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskStatusUpdateRequest, and ValidateTaskMoveRequest classes are missing @Data or @Getter annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data annotation to all request DTO classes: TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskStatusUpdateRequest, and ValidateTaskMoveRequest.

summary: 10 grouped errors found (87 individual compilation errors)
